evidence.name: DNA Analysis
evidence.description: DNA analysis on dry blood stains found on a pillow next to Mary Sullivan's corpse. This helps confirm that the injury occurred in the vicinity of where the blood was found. The analysis also ruled out the presence of any foreign blood from other individuals at the scene, supporting the conclusion that Mary Sullivan was the primary victim of the attack.
truth_base: Mary's blood was the source of the bloodstains
analysis ruled out the presence of any foreign DNA, meaning Mary was primary victim
